correctness.rationale: The exact one-sided quadratures use inverse R_s(u)=U_s^{-1}(u): T_s=sqrt(2) int_0^h R_s'(u)(h-u)^(-1/2)du and A_s=2sqrt(2) int_0^h R_s'(u)(h-u)^(1/2)du. Analytic inversion gives R_s'(u)=alpha A u^(alpha-1)[1-2alpha b A u^alpha+O(u^(2alpha))] with uniform differentiated remainder, alpha=1/k, A=a^-alpha. After u=hq, beta-normalized densities converge in weighted L1; normalization yields the centered first correction -c h^alpha(q^alpha-E_beta Q^alpha) and sharp TV rate if b!=0. Beta recurrence B(alpha,3/2)/B(alpha,1/2)=k/(k+2), combined with rare-side power h^(1/n-1/m), cancels stiffness coefficients to m(n+2)/(n(m+2)). Monomial potentials give exact laws. Independently checked time/area beta moments and period-as-action-derivative in thirteen cases; convergence proof is symbolic.

final_claim: For one-sided real-analytic positive restoring potentials U_s(r)=a_s r^{k_s}(1+b_s r+O(r²)), k_s>=2, the conditional small-energy share Q=U_s(|x|)/h converges in total variation to Beta(1/k_s,1/2) under uniform physical-time orbit sampling and Beta(1/k_s,3/2) under uniform enclosed-area sampling, with explicit centered first Puiseux correction; when orders n<m differ, the vanishing less-flat side time share divided by its area share tends to m(n+2)/(n(m+2)).
